dedupe_keys.name: 3 30 300 indicator for the island of montreal dissemination areas

description: This dataset computes the three 3-30-300 urban greening indicators for every census dissemination area on the island of Montreal, Canada, as a demonstration of the indicator as a tool for assessing access to green space and the inequalities around it. It was published by Eric Robitaille on the Open Science Framework on 14 December 2024. For each dissemination area it gives the percentage of households with a view of at least three trees from home, the percentage of the area under tree canopy, and the proportion of households within 300 metres' walk of a public green space, with the area boundaries for mapping. Coverage is the island of Montreal. Access: a shapefile downloadable from the OSF project. Licence: the DataCite record states no licence, so terms follow the OSF project page; free. Caveats: indicators are aggregated to census areas and depend on the tree and green-space layers used, which are described only briefly. Simulation uses are equity analysis of heat mitigation and green infrastructure, and targeting planting and park investment. Related records: the URBREATH 3-30-300 rasters for four European cities.
